parameters.query:
INSERT INTO sync_events (
    event_key,
    origin,
    entity_type,
    external_id,
    notion_page_id,
    changed_at,
    changed_fields,
    event_payload,
    status,
    processed_at
)
VALUES (
    $1,
    'Notion',
    $2,
    $3,
    $4,
    $5::timestamptz,
    $6::jsonb,
    $7::jsonb,
    $8,
    CASE
        WHEN $8 = 'IGNORED' THEN NOW()
        ELSE NULL
    END
)
ON CONFLICT (event_key)
DO UPDATE SET
    external_id = EXCLUDED.external_id
WHERE
    sync_events.external_id IS NULL
    AND EXCLUDED.external_id IS NOT NULL
RETURNING
    id,
    event_key,
    external_id,
    status;

SELECT
    id,
    event_key,
    origin,
    entity_type,
    external_id,
    notion_page_id,
    changed_at,
    changed_fields,
    status
FROM sync_events
WHERE status = 'RECEIVED'
  AND entity_type = 'Session'
  AND external_id ~ '^BR-S-[0-9]{6}$'
  AND origin = 'Notion'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM jsonb_array_elements(changed_fields) AS f
      WHERE f->>'propertyName' = 'Event Date'
        AND f->>'action' = 'SYNC_CANDIDATE'
  )
ORDER BY changed_at ASC, id ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
    e.id,
    e.event_key,
    e.origin,
    e.external_id,
    e.changed_at,
    e.changed_fields,
    e.status,
    e.event_payload
FROM sync_events e
WHERE e.entity_type = 'Session'
  AND e.external_id = $1
  AND (
      EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM jsonb_array_elements(e.changed_fields) AS f
          WHERE f->>'field' = 'Date'
             OR f->>'propertyName' = 'Event Date'
      )
  )
ORDER BY e.changed_at DESC, e.id DESC;

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO sync_operations (
    event_id,
    entity_type,
    external_id,
    field_name,
    target_system,
    attempted_value,
    status
)
SELECT
    e.id,
    'Session',
    e.external_id,
    'Date',
    'Google',
    to_jsonb($3::text),
    'PENDING'
FROM sync_events e
WHERE e.id = $1::bigint
  AND e.external_id = $2
  AND e.entity_type = 'Session'
  AND e.origin = 'Notion'
  AND e.status = 'RECEIVED'
  AND $4::boolean = true
  AND $5 = 'NOTION_TO_GOOGLE'
  AND $6 = 'DEV_SINGLE_RECORD'
  AND $1::bigint = 21
  AND $2 = 'BR-S-000001'
  AND $3 = '2027-01-22'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM jsonb_array_elements(e.changed_fields) f
      WHERE f->>'propertyName' = 'Event Date'
        AND f->>'action' = 'SYNC_CANDIDATE'
  )
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM sync_operations op
      WHERE op.event_id = e.id
        AND op.field_name = 'Date'
        AND op.target_system = 'Google'
  )
RETURNING
    id,
    event_id,
    external_id,
    field_name,
    target_system,
    attempted_value,
    status;

parameters.query:
WITH completed_operation AS (
    UPDATE sync_operations
    SET
        status = 'SUCCESS',
        completed_at = NOW(),
        error_message = NULL
    WHERE id = 1
      AND event_id = 11
      AND entity_type = 'Session'
      AND external_id = 'BR-S-000001'
      AND field_name = 'Date'
      AND target_system = 'Notion'
      AND attempted_value = to_jsonb('2027-01-20'::text)
      AND status = 'PENDING'
    RETURNING *
),
saved_state AS (
    INSERT INTO sync_field_state (
        entity_type,
        external_id,
        field_name,
        last_synced_value,
        last_synced_at,
        last_event_key
    )
    SELECT
        'Session',
        'BR-S-000001',
        'Date',
        to_jsonb('2027-01-20'::text),
        NOW(),
        e.event_key
    FROM completed_operation op
    JOIN sync_events e ON e.id = op.event_id
    ON CONFLICT (entity_type, external_id, field_name)
    DO UPDATE SET
        last_synced_value = EXCLUDED.last_synced_value,
        last_synced_at = EXCLUDED.last_synced_at,
        last_event_key = EXCLUDED.last_event_key
    RETURNING *
),
closed_events AS (
    UPDATE sync_events
    SET
        status = CASE
            WHEN id = 11 THEN 'APPLIED'
            WHEN id = 4 THEN 'IGNORED'
        END,
        processed_at = NOW()
    WHERE id IN (4, 11)
      AND entity_type = 'Session'
      AND external_id = 'BR-S-000001'
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM saved_state)
    RETURNING id, status
)
SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM completed_operation)
        AS operations_completed,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM saved_state)
        AS field_states_saved,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM closed_events)
        AS events_closed;

    )

nodes.name: DEV — Complete Google Session Date Operation

parameters.query:
WITH ledger AS (

    -- All captured events
    SELECT
        'EVENT' AS record_type,
        e.id AS record_id,
        e.entity_type,
        e.external_id,
        e.origin AS source,
        COALESCE((
            SELECT string_agg(
                COALESCE(
                    f->>'field',
                    f->>'propertyName',
                    '?'
                ) ||
                CASE
                    WHEN f ? 'newValue'
                    THEN ' → ' || (f->>'newValue')
                    ELSE ''
                END,
                ', '
            )
            FROM jsonb_array_elements(e.changed_fields) f
        ), '') AS detail,
        e.status,
        e.changed_at AS activity_at,
        e.processed_at AS completed_at
    FROM sync_events e

    UNION ALL

    -- Synchronization write operations
    SELECT
        'OPERATION',
        o.id,
        o.entity_type,
        o.external_id,
        e.origin || ' → ' || o.target_system,
        o.field_name || ' → ' ||
            COALESCE(o.attempted_value #>> '{}', '?'),
        o.status,
        o.attempted_at,
        o.completed_at
    FROM sync_operations o
    LEFT JOIN sync_events e ON e.id = o.event_id

    UNION ALL

    -- Latest successful shared field values
    SELECT
        'FIELD STATE',
        NULL::bigint,
        s.entity_type,
        s.external_id,
        'Google ↔ Notion',
        s.field_name || ' = ' ||
            COALESCE(s.last_synced_value #>> '{}', '?'),
        'SYNCED',
        s.last_synced_at,
        s.last_synced_at
    FROM sync_field_state s
)

SELECT
    record_type,
    record_id,
    entity_type,
    external_id,
    source,
    detail,
    status,
    activity_at,
    completed_at
FROM ledger
ORDER BY
    activity_at DESC NULLS LAST,
    record_type,
    record_id DESC NULLS LAST;

UPDATE sync_events
SET
    status = 'IGNORED',
    processed_at = NOW()
WHERE id = 20
  AND origin = 'Notion'
  AND entity_type = 'Session'
  AND external_id = 'BR-S-000001'
  AND status = 'RECEIVED'
  AND changed_at BETWEEN
      '2026-11-04T14:39:00Z'::timestamptz
      AND '2026-11-04T14:41:00Z'::timestamptz
RETURNING
    id,
    event_key,
    status,
    processed_at;
